seo.title: Vardhaman Academy – Tuition for Classes 1–10 in Bansilal Nagar
seo.description: Small-batch tuition for Classes 1–10 (CBSE, SSC, ICSE) in Bansilal Nagar, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. Taught in English and Marathi. Book a demo class.

launch_approval.evidence: Owner replied 'now on netlify' in chat on 2026-11-19 approving go-live on va-academy.netlify.app; AI training crawlers kept blocked

approval_record.evidence: Owner supplied 8830499339 and instructed its use for parent enquiries. The same number is printed in source assets media/vardhaman/brand/legacy-brand-poster-img-01.jpeg and legacy-results-poster-img-02.jpeg. Normalized with India's +91 country code; no other flyer number was selected.

Owner confirmed this Google Maps listing is the correct location for the Bansilal Nagar hero badge link, after being shown the pin's address text (which names a different locality, Rajnagar/MIDC, and the owner separately flagged that address text as wrong on Google's side, not the location itself).

Owner asked in chat on 2026-11-21 for a popup lead form on the website that stores parent enquiries (name, mobile, class) in the academy's private leads sheet. Consent wording on /consent/ awaits the academy owner's review.
